x-browser-visitor-device-flow.activation: CLOUD_VISITOR_ENABLED defaults false; requires persistent auth, personal schedules, scoped Agent device binding and the additive browser-visitor migration. Registered-user roster is unchanged.
x-browser-visitor-device-flow.start: POST /api/v1/auth/visitor/session with BrowserVisitorStartRequest (exactly {}), same-origin cookies, Origin, X-Campus-Visitor: 1 and JSON content type. Returns ApiEnvelope data CloudBrowserSession; never accepts owner, device code or token overrides.
x-browser-visitor-device-flow.identity: One independent private browser visitor space, not a school identity. DEV code is a stable public locator derived from an HttpOnly private cookie, never a login credential. Explicit OAuth devices:bind consent supplies the Agent owner; existing different owners cannot be overwritten.
x-browser-visitor-device-flow.failure: No shared demo fallback, no automatic OAuth consent or business writes. Backend restart preserves visitors. Logout revokes the source session and grants; explicit visitor resume must not resurrect old grants. Clearing site cookies can lose visitor identity.

x-oauth-competition-demo-candidate.activation: CLOUD_OAUTH_PILOT_ENABLED=true and CLOUD_OAUTH_COMPETITION_COMPAT_ENABLED=true; separate additive nku_competition_oauth_v1 RPC; original strict provider unchanged.
x-oauth-competition-demo-candidate.protocol: Confidential authorization-code flow without PKCE or refresh. Exact registered school callback, explicit verified owner consent, state 8-256 chars echoed unchanged, 120s one-time code, <=600s Bearer. Token endpoint accepts grant_type/code/redirect_uri plus Basic or body client authentication, not both.
x-oauth-competition-demo-candidate.scope: demo:read only; two approved fictional owners. Existing ApiEnvelope records/time results, B algorithms and browser confirmations unchanged. No owner arguments or model writes.
x-oauth-competition-demo-candidate.limitation: Competition interoperability choice, NOT PKCE-equivalent or production personal-data acceptance. Enabling live compatibility needs concrete action-time confirmation.

x-oauth-local-pilot.protocol_exception: OAuth control endpoints use RFC 6749 responses/redirects instead of ApiEnvelope. Business records/drafts keep ApiEnvelope. No MCP tool or public deployment registers these paths.
x-oauth-local-pilot.security: Exact registered redirect, confidential client authentication, S256 PKCE, explicit owner consent, 120-second one-time code, <=600-second access token, read/optional draft only. No refresh or commit. Platform interoperability is not yet accepted.

x-oauth-cloud-pilot-candidate.time_transport: POST OAuthPilotTimeQueryRequest. query_json is FreeTimeQuery or TimeCheckRequest with workspace_ref omitted. Ownership/saved records come only from demo:read grant; no user/workspace/schedule override. TimeResult uses existing B algorithms with calculation_version, coverage and needs_confirmation. Cloud candidate only; not public MCP or local OAuth paths.
x-oauth-cloud-pilot-candidate.uses: Same OAuthPilot schemas, exact registered callback and OAuth protocol exceptions as the local candidate; no changes to public MCP or A/B/C algorithms.
x-oauth-cloud-pilot-candidate.storage: Isolated nku_identity_pilot_v1 PostgreSQL RPC with online-approved CloudBase owner sessions, persistent consent/code/grant hashes, atomic confirmation/idempotency and shared rate limits.
x-oauth-cloud-pilot-candidate.activation: Requires action-time authorization for new server-side RPC/service access, explicit server-only configuration and live cloud/platform two-user acceptance. Personal uploads remain disabled; no Agent confirm/commit or refresh token.

x-rest-query-encoding.notes: Exactly one query parameter. Use the same object as MCP arguments; all required nullable fields remain explicit null. No dispersed parameters or silent defaults.

x-cloud-browser-session-candidate.transport: No query/body/owner/bearer inputs. Same-origin credentials=include and X-Campus-Session-Read: 1; reject explicit foreign Origin or Sec-Fetch-Site. ApiEnvelope data is CloudBrowserSession.
x-cloud-browser-session-candidate.security: Original HttpOnly session plus MAC-bound Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite=Strict 15-minute resume context and PG owner validation. Read only; no token/CSRF rotation, expiry extension, OAuth consent or business commit. Pre-candidate sessions lacking context require one fresh login. No CORS, no-store, no raw CloudBase UID or primary session token in JSON.

x-notice-text-cloud-candidate.activation: CLOUD_NOTICE_TEXT_PILOT_ENABLED and existing closed two-owner identity configuration; separate additive notice-text migration
x-notice-text-cloud-candidate.storage: Existing verified identity and workspaces; new isolated drafts/confirmations/tasks/idempotency only. No Agent confirm/commit. New input is explicitly fictional.

query_json.description: FreeTimeQuery (free-slots) or TimeCheckRequest (check) JSON object text, omitting workspace_ref. Preserve all other required fields including explicit null. Reject duplicate keys, non-finite values and owner/schedule overrides. Bearer demo:read grants select saved records; missing timetable is NOT_FOUND, not public-fixture fallback.

x-task-calendar-candidate.activation: CLOUD_TASK_CALENDAR_ENABLED plus CLOUD_NOTICE_TEXT_PILOT_ENABLED; apply reviewed calendar migration after notice-text
x-task-calendar-candidate.ownership: Cookie/CSRF for browser writes; OAuth demo:read summary only; caller workspace is an ownership check
x-task-calendar-candidate.storage: Two RLS tables, independent CAS and owner-scoped idempotency; original notice remains immutable; replaces notice snapshot to share busy state
